services.desc: A Unique Boating Experience on the St. Lawrence River ​Our top-of-the-line 24-foot Sweetwater by Godfrey pontoons are the perfect way to experience the river. ​ With 115hp engines, spacious layouts, and a bimini top for shade, they're built for comfort, fun, and easy cruising. ​ Whether you're looking to explore hidden coves, picnic by a historic castle, or simply soak up the sun with family and friends, Wagoner Pontoons provides the perfect vessel for making lasting memories! blurb: Wagoner's Marina provides winter storage for various types of boats including pontoons and sailboats, dockage and mooring solutions, marine mechanic services, seasonal trailer lots, and dredging and barging services. They offer custom dock building and repair, engine work, winterization, and environmental dredging. Seasonal trailer lots include water and septic and run from May 1st to October 15th.
